title: cleanup_orphan_msg_files silently ends scan on next_entry() error
description: relay_queue.rs cleanup_orphan_msg_files() uses 'while let Ok(Some(entry)) = dir.next_entry().await' to scan directory entries. When next_entry() returns Err (e.g. EBADF, EIO), the loop treats the error identically to end-of-directory and exits silently. Orphan .msg files that follow the error in directory order are never inspected. Idiomatic Rust would distinguish Err from None: match dir.next_entry().await { Ok(Some(e)) => ..., Ok(None) => break, Err(e) => { warn!(...); break; } }. The same silent-stop pattern appears in drain_once() as well. The consequence is that startup cleanup is incomplete after a partial readdir failure, leaving orphan files that accumulate silently.
